title: Algebraic Groups Are Closed Subgroups of GL_n
body_html:
Algebraic Groups Are Closed Subgroups of GL_n

Let \(k\) be a field and \(G\) an algebraic group over \(\operatorname{Spec} k\). There exist a positive integer \(n\) and a closed immersion of group schemes

\[ G \;\hookrightarrow\; \operatorname{GL}_n \]

over \(\operatorname{Spec} k\).
proof_html:
Apply the embedding theorem to obtain a faithful finite-dimensional representation \((W, \rho)\) of \(G\). Choose a basis of \(W\); the choice induces a group scheme isomorphism \(\operatorname{GL}(W) \simeq \operatorname{GL}_n\) where \(n = \dim_k W\). Composing \(\rho\) with this isomorphism gives the required closed immersion.
\(\square\)

This corollary is the historically classical form of the theorem (Borel, Linear Algebraic Groups, §1.10) and motivates the term linear algebraic group as a synonym for algebraic group over a field.
